say:4:1810551201:0.text: There, that should do it. Hilda, the pain's gone now. Relax...
say:4:1810551201:0.source_cn: 这样便好了。希尔达，你身上已经不疼了，放松些……

say:5:1810551202:0.text: Hilda is still breathing heavily. Her body and soul don't seem fully in sync, and her reactions remain sluggish.
say:5:1810551202:0.source_cn: “希尔达”仍然喘着粗气。不知是不是因为灵魂与躯体的不匹...

say:6:1810551203:0.text: Baba Muriel hums that song again, gently resting her left hand on Hilda's shoulder, patting gently and rhythmically.
say:6:1810551203:0.source_cn: 仿佛想要安抚她一样，穆婆婆再次哼起那首歌谣，又伸出左手...

say:10:1810551204:0.text: Rain and Thane both watch quietly. Their eyes are fixed on her left hand.
say:10:1810551204:0.source_cn: 温柔哼唱声里，你注意到了瑟恩和里纳的视线。它们不约而同...
say:10:1810551204:0.male: Rain and Thane both watch quietly. Their eyes are fixed on her left hand.
say:10:1810551204:0.female: Rain and Thane both watch quietly. Their eyes are fixed on her left hand.

say:11:1810551205:0.text: Whenever Baba comforts someone, she always pats their left shoulder with her left hand... It feels so familiar.
say:11:1810551205:0.source_cn: 婆婆安慰人的时候，总是喜欢用左手拍别人的左肩……我一直...

say:12:1810551206:0.text: Even when I had just woken up and knew absolutely nothing, as long as she patted my shoulder like that, I would slowly calm down. I just couldn't help but trust her...
say:12:1810551206:0.source_cn: 哪怕是刚刚醒来，什么都不知道的时候，只要婆婆这样拍拍我...

say:13:1810551207:0.text: Was that... because of Bayanu too?
say:13:1810551207:0.source_cn: 这也是因为巴亚茄先生吗？

say:14:1810551208:0.text: Yes. Back when we went to the Whispering Isles, we were young. We'd just received... bad news. That's how he comforted us.
say:14:1810551208:0.source_cn: 嗯，我们去幽声群岛的时候还很年轻，当时收到了……一些不...

say:18:1810551210:1.text: I'm starting to believe what you and Estrilda told me. But I don't know when I'll ever remember my past...
say:18:1810551210:1.source_cn: ……我开始有些相信你和爱丝说的话了。但我不知道什么时候...

say:19:1810551211:0.text: It's okay. We've found you already. Take your time.
say:19:1810551211:0.source_cn: 没关系，我们已经找到你了，慢慢来！

say:20:1810551212:1.text: Yes. We have plenty of time ahead of us.
say:20:1810551212:1.source_cn: 嗯，我们还有很长的时间。

narration:21:1810551213:0.text: Under the strange song, the full moon slowly wanes...
narration:21:1810551213:0.source_cn: 在奇特的歌声之中，圆月渐渐变化……

narration:22:1810551214:0.text: Before it disappears completely, Hilda finally regains her strength.
narration:22:1810551214:0.source_cn: 赶在满月消失前，“希尔达”终于恢复了力量
